Why this design

Working persona: Dr. Arjun Patel, owner-periodontist. Hypothesis: A letter beside its source, with direct links to source sections, helps the specialist find omissions and finish review. Tradeoff: The full letter still needs careful reading. Compare the supplied-note and missing-follow-up cases; these are design hypotheses, not measured outcomes.
